cybersecurityManagerLicence.title: Cybersecurity Manager Licence
cybersecurityManagerLicence.description: Licence attesting the professional competence of a natural person as a cybersecurity manager. A conformity assessment body accredited under ISO/IEC 17024 issues it under the certification scheme of the Slovak National Security Authority (NBÚ) and the knowledge standard of NBÚ Decree No. 492/2022 Coll., Annex 5. The role corresponds to the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) role profile of ENISA's European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF) v1. Domain: cybersecurity professional qualifications. Its status is the licence's record on the licence registry contract named in credentialStatus. VCDM 1.1; extends the EBSI Verifiable Attestation.

licenceStatusEntry.title: Licence Record on the Licence Registry
licenceStatusEntry.description: Type extension for credentialStatus in the Slovak Professional Licence Registry. Its PlrLedgerStatusEntry names the licence registry contract (chain and address) that keeps the licence's record. A verifier computes the record's key from the issuer's DID and the credential's id, so the entry carries no key. VCDM 1.1; extends the EBSI Verifiable Attestation.

credentialStatus.description: One entry must be the PlrLedgerStatusEntry; other status entries may sit beside it.
